mathematics: Reuses the actual material_height_coefficient_power_bounded theorem, whose H exponent is strictly positive and whose E0 exponent may be any real number.
Raises the true point/sample H ratio to beta>0, factors gamma=(gamma-beta)+beta, and absorbs the remaining H^(gamma-beta) E0^(R+A beta).
One actual midpoint cell is selected before all gamma,beta,R, components, states and points. Its original H normalizer comparison and all sample E0 comparisons are retained.
For every 0<beta<gamma and every real R the actual point H^gamma E0^R is bounded by a constant times H(sample)^beta uniformly over the whole positive component within the core.
No E0>=1, whole-component common-cell, reverse endpoint-to-sample E0 comparison, material replacement, final primitive estimate or Through03 transfer is assumed.
